scope_statement.question: On 2 pre-specified layers, do 4 per-domain calibration-greedy layouts show a clear cross-domain crossover advantage (rows track own base) over 4 per-domain evaluation captures?
scope_statement.explicitly_not_answered: whether any whole-service (full-model, live scheduling) benefit or harm exists - no service-caliber extrapolation, no break-even claim, no multiplication by service-time shares in any verdict
scope_statement.opportunity_vs_exploitability_separation: replay harness contains NO controller; this pilot measures OPPORTUNITY only. Exploitability by the old controller is answered separately from existing five-arm logs (see results/ea_v1/workload_variation/log_check_w_reset_cost.json). Any future controller revision is developed and validated on calibration split only; the five-arm A11/A00 failure record is retained verbatim, never rewritten or re-run.

hardware_software_lock: one node, 8x NVIDIA H20, EP=8, DeepEP normal dispatch/combine, DeepGEMM FP8, Qwen3-235B-A22B-FP8 (128 logical experts, top-8, 16 local/rank, 128-row alignment); identical model/service/replay tooling as crosstab_v1 (frozen code lock to be hash-verified at launch)

layer_selection.rule_pre_registered: one layer with minimal and one with maximal within-domain oracle gap in crosstab_v1 (single-domain prior study; no cross-domain data consulted): layer-024 (gap 0.00%) and layer-071 (gap 0.50%)

captures.structure: 4 domains x 2 layers x {1 calibration-split capture (layout construction ONLY), 1 evaluation-split capture (timing row ONLY)}
captures.mechanism: existing prediction_v1 snapshot_split trigger (mode=snapshot_split, min_hidden_rows=400, expected_layers=94, identity service map required); capture responses + forward_rank*.pt + assignment metadata per unit
captures.service_runs: 2 real service runs on the real workloads: run C over calibration.jsonl (8037 req), run E over evaluation.jsonl (7963 req); concurrency 256, original order, identical server flags to five-arm launcher

trigger_points_client_request_index.rule: segment midpoints; >=700 requests from any domain boundary >> 256 in-flight; index-driven (deterministic), no timing guesses

captures.domain_purity_caveat_pre_registered: per-batch domain composition is not recorded anywhere and cannot be verified for captured batches (report_v2 fix 2); midpoint triggering bounds contamination risk but does not prove purity; this assumption is stated in every output artifact

candidate_layouts.builder: frozen greedy builder, identical code and parameters to crosstab_v1 base-of-* construction, inputs = assignment metadata of the CALIBRATION capture of that domain and layer only
candidate_layouts.evaluation_split_usage: evaluation captures are timing rows ONLY: never an input to layout construction, never used to select captures, columns, blocks or starts

replay_matrix.same_process_semantics: for each capture (row), ALL 5 columns are re-timed inside the same start processes so own-vs-other contrasts are internally consistent (crosstab_v1 semantics)
replay_matrix.start_semantics: one fresh torchrun process group per start; immutable artifacts reloaded and weights rebuilt before warmup
replay_matrix.within_block_column_order: rotated by (start_index + block_index) mod 5 (pre-registered rotation, balanced; pairing is within block)
replay_matrix.cell_estimate: mean over valid starts of the 5-block mean

statistics_plan_pre_registered.primary_contrasts: per layer, per row d: three paired contrasts T(x_d, L_d') - T(x_d, L_d) for each other-domain layout L_d'; start-level means of within-block paired differences; t975(df=3)=3.1824463052837078
statistics_plan_pre_registered.margin_provenance: inherited from crosstab_v1 (same replay caliber, same harness); not re-tuned
statistics_plan_pre_registered.row_tracks_own_base: ALL THREE other-base-minus-own-base CIs exclude zero positively

verdict_rule.detected: >=1 of the 2 layers shows clear crossover advantage
verdict_rule.not_detected: 0 layers show it and no layer is indeterminate
verdict_rule.indeterminate: any layer with >=2 rows having <3 valid starts, or mixed outcome not meeting either rule
verdict_rule.verdict_wording_constraint: verdicts speak ONLY about the chosen layers and candidates at replay caliber; never about whole-service benefit or harm in either direction

statistics_plan_pre_registered.validity_and_failures: start valid iff boots clean, correctness gates pass, all 5 columns x 5 blocks timed; failed starts are retired, NEVER retried under this frozen pilot; row with <3 valid starts = indeterminate row
statistics_plan_pre_registered.no_selection: no best-start, best-block, best-capture, best-column, prefix or subset selection; no significance-driven extra runs; extension beyond 40 cells requires a NEW pre-registered protocol (explicitly NOT an automatic path to the old 160-start design)

secondary_descriptive_never_in_verdict.oracle_gap: per layer: T_static_cand = min_p sum_d K_d T(x_d,p); T_switch_cand = sum_d K_d min_p T(x_d,p); reported twice: row-equal K and K-tilde weighted
secondary_descriptive_never_in_verdict.K_tilde_assumption_note_mandatory: K_tilde = evaluation token shares, an EXOGENOUS approximation of each domain's service relevance; replay rows are row-count-matched by design (~4050 hidden rows), so K_tilde weighting is an assumption-flagged approximation, not a replay-measured quantity; no service-share multiplication (report_v2 fix 4) may be applied to these numbers
secondary_descriptive_never_in_verdict.migration_cost_note: pairwise displacement between L_d maps -> frozen C_batch(k) cost-model estimates of per-switch migration cost and break-even segment length, reported as descriptive context only

statistics_plan_pre_registered.ci_wording: an interval crossing zero is reported as compatible with zero, never as proof of no effect; negative effects preserved exactly

correctness_gates.provenance: identical gate values to crosstab_v1 frozen protocol

budget_exact.replay_gpu_hours: 32 starts x ~12 min (crosstab_v1 measured mean per start) = ~6.4 GPU-h
budget_exact.capture_gpu_hours: 2 service runs x (boot ~20 min + bench to last trigger ~5-6 min) = ~1.0 GPU-h
budget_exact.explicit_non_escalation: this pilot replaces the previously proposed 160-start Phase A; the 30-start Phase B service experiment remains NOT proposed and requires separate user instruction plus a new frozen protocol

launch_preconditions: explicit user approval of this protocol
hash-lock manifest of all inputs (capture tooling, greedy builder, replay harness, server launcher flags, workloads, identity map, selected_layers.json) written and verified before first boot
config verification per start (server args dump + map shas) with mismatch = abort, not retire
GPUs idle and exclusive for the session

artifacts_planned.records_per_start: boot log, config verify, correctness gate results, per-block per-column fenced timings, diag sha256
artifacts_planned.analysis_output: cdx0_analysis.json + cdx0_summary.md written once by a frozen analyzer; refuses overwrite
